subject: CrescentPay - activation sprint & API seeding cadence
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sam Cho <sam@crescentpay.com>, Amir Rahman <amir@crescentpay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CrescentPay - activation sprint & API seeding cadence

Hi Sam / Amir —

Thanks for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I want to propose a short activation sprint to get your initial workspace tenant stood up and seeded with API credentials so your engineering team can start test-ing against the API next week. High level plan: 

- Week 0 (this week): Create org + project namespaces, define roles, seed two service API keys for initial integration (non-prod)
- Week 1: Invite admin and developer users, enable KV/cache buckets, run smoke test on sample prompts
- Week 2: Rotate keys to production pattern, confirm SSO and KMS binding, handoff to ops/CS

Ask: please confirm your preferred window for invites (we typically do 9a-11a PT or 1p-3p PT) and whether you want us to seed keys as standard API keys or if you prefer using a Google Cloud service account mapped to Redwood (we can bind to your KMS). 

I've attached an initial access checklist and a short kickoff agenda. Monica and Dev are looped to own invites and key seeding. Stephanie will manage the sprint schedule.

Next steps I’ll take once you confirm invite window: create the project namespaces, upload the role matrix to the Drive folder, and send invites with scoped roles.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you running.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: crescentpay-access-checklist.pdf
From: Sam Cho <sam@crescentpay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Amir Rahman <amir@crescentpay.com>

Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CrescentPay - activation sprint & API seeding cadence

Thanks Ben — quick clarifying q's: 

1) For the seeded API keys, do you generate service account style keys or standard long-lived tokens? We prefer short-lived keys and would like rotation to be automated where possible.
2) We already have a GCP service account used by other infra automation. Can Redwood accept a GCP SA for authentication, or do we need separate keys?
3) Invite window: 1p-3p PT works best for our team on Tues or Wed next week.

If you can say whether the initial keys will expire or be rotatable via API, we can confirm the timing.

Subject: Re: CrescentPay - activation sprint & API seeding cadence

Hi Sam / Amir —

Great questions. Short answers up front: we can accept a GCP service account for authentication (recommended for infra automation) and we will seed short-lived OAuth-based service tokens where possible and provide rotation guidance. Concrete plan below: 

- Role matrix: we will create the following roles in your workspace: platform-admin, billing-admin, dev-integrator, read-only-observability. See attached role CSV for exact permissions.
- Keys: for initial integration we will seed two non-prod API tokens scoped to dev-integrator and platform-admin respectively; both will be created with a 90-day TTL and a recommended rotation workflow via our Keys API. If you provide a GCP SA, we will bind it to your workspace and mint short-lived tokens via KMS on your rotation schedule.
- Invites: we will send invites to 1p-3p PT next Tue (2028-06-20) unless you ask for Wed. Monica will send admin invites; Dev will create namespaces and seed keys; Stephanie will publish the sprint timeline in the Drive folder.

Action items for CrescentPay: confirm whether you want us to bind the existing GCP SA (please share SA email) and pick Tue/Wed window.

Drive kickoff folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-crescentpay-onboard
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example/deal/4892

Thanks — I’ve attached the role matrix CSV for your review.

—
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

Attachments: crescentpay-role-matrix.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: CrescentPay - activation sprint & API seeding cadence

Thanks all — quick update and confirmation: 

- CrescentPay confirmed Tue 2028-06-20 1p-3p PT for invites. Monica will send the admin invites and Dev will seed the two non-prod API tokens immediately after invites are accepted.
- Monica: please bind the provided GCP SA email (amir-sa@crescentpay.com) to the workspace and document the KMS binding steps in the Drive folder.
- Stephanie: schedule the 3-day smoke-test window starting 2028-06-21 and add the canary prompt suite to the Drive folder.

Attached final checklist for the activation sprint and the role matrix you reviewed. After invites and initial smoke tests we’ll schedule a 30-minute handoff with your engineering leads and our Implementation Engineer to confirm production roll pattern.

If anything changes on your side, ping me directly. Otherwise we’ll proceed to create namespaces and seed keys on Monday.

—
Ben Carter
